# Hermes Helmet

> Hermes Helmet is an open-source software factory that gives Hermes Agent the ability to keep going, carrying accepted GitHub work through implementation, review, repair and authorized merge.

The product name in prose is Hermes Helmet. The CLI is `helmet`. You are the Captain; your coding agent is the first officer on the Captain host; Hermes is the crew and implements under a separate worker identity. This file is an index into the public repository, not a second manual. Digest and tag values live in the runtime image guide.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/README.md): Product overview, roles, planning boundary, and documentation map.
- [Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/quickstart.md): Install the host CLI and start the published worker image. The CLI install does not pull or restart the worker.
- [Published runtime](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/runtime-image.md): Canonical image pin, Compose selection, development builds, and upgrades.

## First-officer delivery

Use these when you are the coding-agent first officer on the Captain host. The implementing worker does not run these orchestration skills.

- Installing first-officer skills into Claude Code or Codex: [First-officer plugin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/first-officer-plugins.md).
- Configuring or reusing a first-officer session: [Starting a first-officer session](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/first-officer-plugins.md#starting-a-first-officer-session).
- Coordinating delivery and review of one issue: [helmet-issue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/skills/helmet-issue/SKILL.md).
- Coordinating dependent issues: [helmet-epic](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/skills/helmet-epic/SKILL.md).
- Configuring identities and the worker: [setup-helmet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/skills/setup-helmet/SKILL.md).

## Changing this repository

- Contributor instructions: [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/AGENTS.md) and [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). Run `scripts/verify.sh`.
- Reporting a vulnerability: [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/SECURITY.md). Do not open a public issue with an exploit or a secret.
- Publishing material about Hermes Helmet: [Brand attribution and logos](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/brand.md).

## Operating model

- [Captain, first officer, and crew](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/captain-and-crew.md): Roles, delivery contract, and merge authority. The worker never merges.
- [Authority schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/authority-schema.md): Policy fields for identities, allowlists, labels, budgets, and merge rules.
- [Control loop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/control-loop.md): Issue intake, trusted review, same-PR repair, and the merge gate.
- [setup-helmet reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/setup-helmet.md): Setup commands and diagnostics.
- [helmet-issue reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/helmet-issue.md): First-officer single-issue orchestration.
- [helmet-epic reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/helmet-epic.md): First-officer dependent-issue orchestration.
- [Private overlay](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/private-overlay.md): Company policy, mounts, and state outside this repository. Optional; not a product prerequisite.
